claim: An account can have 10 custom key stores in each Region by default, and the quota is adjustable. The quota counts all AWS CloudHSM key stores and external key stores together, regardless of their connection state.

qualifiers.condition: counts AWS CloudHSM key stores and external key stores, regardless of their connection state

evidence.quote: | [Custom key store resource quota](#cks-resource-quota) | 10 | AWS account and Region | Yes |
evidence.table_header: | Quota name | Default value | Applies to | Adjustable |

evidence.quote: This quota applies to the total number of custom key stores in each account and region, including all AWS CloudHSM key stores and external key stores, regardless of their connection state.
